product.description:
Features:

  • Freezer is certified for UL
  • The fast freeze feature restores set temperature for optimum food freshness
  • Freezer alarm goes off when the door is left open
  • 3 full-width, adjustable door storage bins help with upright freezer organization
  • Clear slide out storage bin
  • This accessible freezer makes it easy to organize and find your favorite frozen foods thanks to 3 wire shelves, which are all adjustable, and 1 glass bin cover
  • Covered under a 1 year limited manufacturer warranty

Specifications:

  • Total Capacity: 7.0 Cu. Ft.
  • Freezer Type: Column
  • Defrost Type: Manual
  • Depth: 21-11/16"
  • Height: 33-1/2"
  • Width: 32-1/8"
  • Amperage: 15, 20A
  • Voltage: 115V
